exposure: missense mutation c.685G>A in the KCNJ11 gene
comprehensive genetic testing with targeted next-generation sequencing and 6q24 methylation analysis
cohort: The study describes two cases of extremely preterm, 24 weeks' gestational age triplets diagnosed with transient neonatal diabetes mellitus due to a KCNJ11 gene mutation.
finding: Comprehensive genetic testing helps identify monogenic diabetes early, allowing for successful transition from insulin to sulfonylurea (Glyburide) treatment and improved metabolic and glycemic control in patients with KCNJ11 mutations.
